fact: Car 10 allegedly impeding Car 22 in turn 17.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 22 (Yuki Tsunoda), the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 22 stated that he actually received a "tow" from Car 10 and did not have to back off in speed. This was verified by the telemetry. He further stated he was not impeded and did not need to take any evasive action. In view of the above the Stewards decide to take no further action because no "unnecessary impeding" occurred.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 10 Allegedly Impeding Car 22
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
